notes: Table-based layout with listings organized by category. Each listing row contains title with link, ID#, asking price, county, and state. The selector picks up some navigation rows that need filtering (rows with "Home" as title), but successfully extracts 4+ actual business listings. URL field extracts link text instead of href attribute. Post-processing should filter rows where ID is not numeric and convert relative URLs to absolute (e.g., 1301.htm -> http://www.bassoassociates.com/1301.htm).
